# One template per block: `=== <name> <bas|cls>`, then the module text. `{k}` is replaced by each word of words.txt.
=== args0 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}()
End Sub
=== args1 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1)
End Sub
=== args2 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1, 2)
End Sub
=== args3 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1, 2, 3)
End Sub
=== args4 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1, 2, 3, 4)
End Sub
=== args5 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
End Sub
=== leadgap bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(, 1)
End Sub
=== trailgap bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1, )
End Sub
=== midgap bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1, , 2)
End Sub
=== bare bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}
End Sub
=== nobracket bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k} 1
End Sub
=== stmt0 bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}()
End Sub
=== stmt1 bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}(1)
End Sub
=== callstmt bas
Sub Probe()
    Call {k}(1)
End Sub
=== operand bas
Sub Probe()
    x = 1 + {k}(1)
End Sub
=== member bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(1).y
End Sub
=== named bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(a:=1)
End Sub
=== namearg1 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(a)
End Sub
=== namearg2 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(a, 1)
End Sub
=== namearg3 bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(a, 1, 2)
End Sub
=== namemember bas
Sub Probe()
    x = {k}(a).y
End Sub
=== namecallstmt bas
Sub Probe()
    Call {k}(a)
End Sub
=== namestmt bas
Sub Probe()
    {k}(a)
End Sub
=== nameargs bas
Sub Probe()
    {k} a, 1
End Sub
=== withparen bas
Sub Probe()
    x = ({k})
End Sub
